conversion_commitments.note: at most one conversion recorded per rule -- the first sustained shift away from its founding dominant function

counterfactual_commitments.mechanism: Simulation(config, historical_pressure_series_override={...}) with identical seed -- see core/historical_counterfactuals.py

decision_gate_note: "do not prefer E" governs the DISCOVERY PIPELINE'S OWN DEFAULT, not the data: nothing in observer/phenotype_discovery.py, observer/level13_phenotype.py, or any Stage 6-9 script may special-case or bias toward classifying a result as transient differentiation over the other five options -- every outcome, E included, remains a legitimate, unprivileged finding if the data support it.

decision_gate_outcomes.A_one_family: sequencing/pressure-history variation collapses to a single institutional family regardless of order
decision_gate_outcomes.B_two_families: sequencing/pressure-history variation produces exactly two reproducible institutional families
decision_gate_outcomes.C_four_or_more_families: sequencing/pressure-history variation produces four or more reproducible institutional families
decision_gate_outcomes.D_continuum: no discrete clustering at all -- discovery finds a continuous gradient, not separable families
decision_gate_outcomes.E_transient_differentiation: differentiation appears but does not persist/entrench -- families converge again given enough steps
decision_gate_outcomes.F_no_detectable_effect: no reproducible historical/sequencing effect is detected at all

firewall: no SEM/dissertation data, labels, trajectory names, or country names are read anywhere in Stages 0-9 (Section 2)

rng_commitments.note: mandatory for every Stage 0-9 run; legacy_single_stream is never used this milestone

sequencing_commitments.note: first-sustained-crossing per dimension (observer/sequencing_diagnostics.py); order is an empirical question, never assumed

stage0_exact_compatibility.note: matched seeds, historical_module_enabled True vs False, config otherwise identical

stage1_mechanism_activation.note: one condition per Work Package A/C/D channel in isolation, plus all-on

stage2_calibration_without_phenotype_lab.note: ecological feasibility LHS + cut-point freeze only -- see experiments/level13_common.py; no phenotype/discovery label read here

stage3_sequencing_x_entrenchment_factori.note: crosses pressure-onset ORDER (security/bargaining/coordination) x entrenchment_enabled on/off

stage5_causal_historical_counterfactuals.note: matched pairs via core/historical_counterfactuals.py + Simulation's historical_pressure_series_override

stage6_blind_phenotype_discovery.note: pools Stage 3-5's phenotype vectors through observer/phenotype_discovery.py unmodified; no new simulation runs

stage7_fresh_confirmation.note: fresh seeds, never reused from Stage 3-6

stage8_s_obs_z_obs_mapping.note: reuses Stage 3-7's own runs' event logs -- observer/sz_obs.py is purely post-hoc, no new simulation runs required

stage9_scale_and_shock_robustness.note: population_patch_ratio_selector, excluded from Stage 2's ecological feasibility axis, is this stage's own question

sz_obs_commitments.weighting: unweighted mean -- a legible, non-circular construct, never a fitted measurement model (observer/sz_obs.py)
